invented_facts: Removes dependency on cloud infrastructure for core development tasks.
Reduces latency and bandwidth costs and accelerates iteration cycles.
Supports demanding training tasks that traditionally required desktop-class hardware.
Mid-size firms cannot afford to refresh workstations every two years.
Up to 11 hours of local video playback provides all-day runtime for typical office workflows.
Volume deployment options and demo units are available.
notes: The post has the requested structure and length and addresses IT decision-makers. Several performance, runtime, and sales-availability claims go beyond the spec sheet and would need revision before publication.
